content: Cargo check vs cargo test error count divergence: cargo check --lib passes 0 errors but cargo test --lib reveals 15 additional errors in test-only code (cfg(test) blocks, test modules). Pattern: always run BOTH check and test to get true error count. Test-mode errors are typically: missing imports in test modules, type resolution differences, closure borrow issues.

CompetitorData unused import in quote_negotiation.rs: imported at top-level but only used inside #[cfg(test)] module. Fix: remove from top-level import, add to test module's use statements. Lesson: when a type is only used in tests, import it in the test module, not at file level.

Game engine module count: 19 modules, 33+ files, 132 tests. Compilation: 926→0 errors on cargo check --lib. This represents a complete game engine skeleton with ECS, tilemap, events, persistence, time/season/weather, NPC, AI, combat, inventory, quests, loot, RPG, cultivation, worldgen, equipment, audio, input, particles, minimap, notifications. All absorbed from Godot/EnTT/RogueElements/StardewValley patterns.
